TITLE:
10 numbers in 3 seconds —
can you remember them?
NEXT: NEXT: The picture is changing — why don't we notice?

EN.숫자 10개가 딱 3초만 나와요\n사라지면 소리 내 말해 보세요:
10 digits will show for just 3 seconds.
When they disappear, say them out loud
EN.기억나는 만큼\n말해 보세요!:
Say as many
as you can remember!
EN.몇 개 맞았나요?\n뒤쪽은 가물가물하죠?:
How many did you get?
The last ones are fuzzy, right?
EN.이번엔 다른 숫자\n세 묶음으로 나눠서 보여 줄게요:
Now different digits,
split into three groups
EN.어때요?\n아까보다 쉬웠죠?:
How was it?
Easier than before, right?
EN.머릿속엔 잠깐 기억해 두는\n칸이 몇 개 없어요:
Your brain has only a few slots
for holding things for a moment
EN.숫자 하나에 한 칸씩 쓰면\n금방 꽉 차서 밀려나요:
One digit per slot fills them up fast,
and the first ones get pushed out
EN.세 개씩 묶으면\n한 칸에 한 묶음!:
Group them by three —
one group per slot!
EN.숫자 10개가 칸 3개에 쏙\n한 칸이 아직 남았어요:
10 digits fit into 3 slots,
with one slot still free
EN.이렇게 길게 붙어 있으면\n외우기 힘들죠?:
When it's all stuck together like this,
it's hard to remember, right?
EN.그래서 전화번호도\n끊어서 적고 외워요:
That's why we write and remember
phone numbers in chunks
EN.잘게 쪼개지 말고 묶어서!\n한 칸에 더 많이 담겨요:
Don't split it up — group it!
Each slot holds more
